{{Quote|The location isn't a problem. I have the last two months' worth of the ''Springhawk''{{'s}} navigational data.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''All right. But shouldn't we check first with Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo?''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''We're going now precisely because I don't want Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo to know about it. I've sent him on a security sweep of the nearby systems, which should give us time to examine the battle zone and return. And only then will we ask for his version of the battle.|translated=1|Admiral Ar'alani and Jorj Car'das|<ref name="OF" />}}
'''Ar'alani's inspection group''' was an inspection group consisting of [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrass," of the [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]] and their reluctant guide, [[Jorj Car'das]], that was led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]] to investigate the [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (destruction of Special Task Force One)|battle zone]] after the [[Destruction of Special Task Force One|destruction]] of [[Special Task Force One]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

==History==
===Creation===
{{Quote|I still maintain that Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo fought only in self-defense.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''Did the unknown enemy fire first?''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''The firing of weapons isn't always the first act of aggression. The Trade Federation battleships launched a massive force of droid starfighters. I've read reports of battles in which these weapons were used, and if Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo hadn't acted to neutralize them, his force would quickly have been overwhelmed.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''Perhaps. We'll know better once you've shown us around the battle zone.|translated=1|Jorj Car'das and Admiral Ar'alani|<ref name="OF" />}}
[[File:Jorj.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Admiral Ar'alani recruited Jorj Car'das (pictured) to investigate the Trade Federation battle zone.]]
Following the [[Destruction of Special Task Force One|destruction]] of [[Special Task Force One]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn," of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] was ordered to return to the [[Crustai asteroid base]] to meet the returning [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]]. She dispatched him on a security sweep of nearby [[Star system/Legends|systems]] while she conducted an apparent investigation into his latest act of aggression.<ref name="OF" /> 

At the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] base, [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] eventually went to speak with Thrawn, although he encountered [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]], core name "Thrass," of the [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]]. Thrass took Car'das to the quarters of Admiral Ar'alani at the upper level of the base, where she began questioning Car'das about the latest incident involving the Trade Federation vessels. Car'das tried to stall Ar'alani by stating that Thrawn acted within the scope of the [[Expansionary Fleet's charter]] and fought only in self-defense. Ar'alani questioned him if the enemy conducted a preemptive strike instead, and Car'das replied that the mere act of launching [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] was an act of aggression. While Car'das pretended he did not know where the battle took place, Ar'alani revealed to him that she possessed a [[Code cylinder/Legends|data cylinder]] with the last two months' navigational data of Thrawn's [[Cruiser/Legends|Chiss attack cruiser]] ''[[Springhawk/Legends|Springhawk]]'', including the location of the Trade Federation [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (destruction of Special Task Force One)|battle zone]]. Ar'alani then recruited Car'das, who reluctantly agreed, perceiving that he had no other choice. With the inspection group assembled, they traveled to the battle zone, where Thrawn had destroyed the Trade Federation [[Task force/Legends|task force]].<ref name="OF" />

===Inspection===
{{Dialogue|Ar'alani|Fourteen vessels. Possibly thirteen, if the two sections of wreckage to the right belonged to a single vessel that broke apart before exploding.|Thrass|Is that the correct number, Car'das?|Jorj Car'das|Yes, that's sounds about right. Of course, I was just an observer. I didn't have access to the sensor information.|attr=Admiral Ar'alani, Syndic Mitth'ras'safis and Jorj Car'das|src=<ref name="OF" />|line1=trans|line2=trans|line3=trans}}
[[File:OutboundFlightEnd-TEA.jpg|250px|thumb|right|Ar'alani's inspection group examined the wreckage at the Trade Federation battle zone.]]
At the Trade Federation battle zone, Admiral Ar'alani examined the wreckage with Thrass and Car'das, who was relieved to discover that the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] ''[[Darkvenge]]'' was not there. From looking at the debris field, Ar'alani discerned that fourteen or thirteen vessels were destroyed by Thrawn. After learning about [[Droid/Legends|droids]] from Car'das, Ar'alani found no evidence that Trade Federation droid [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] attacked first. Car'das tried to convince Thrass and Ar'alani that Thrawn's actions against the Trade Federation were justified using his earlier argument about the starfighters, but was worried about what would happen to him and his companions if the Admiral chose to bring up charges against the [[Commander/Legends|Commander]]. The inspection group returned to the [[Crustai system/Legends|Crustai]] [[Unidentified asteroid (Crustai system)|asteroid]] base nearly two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] before Thrawn returned from the inspection tour that Ar'alani sent him on.<ref name="OF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ar'alani's inspection group first appeared in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="OF" />
